basic_details.job_title: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) Apprenticeship Training 2026 for Graduate & Diploma - 147 Posts, Apply Online
basic_details.organization_name: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), Kanchanbagh Unit, Hyderabad

qualification.details: Reservations for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/CAP are applicable as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

salary_details.details: Graduate Apprentice (B.E./B.Tech): Rs. 12,300 per month Diploma Apprentice: Rs. 10,900 per month | Of this stipend, 50% will be paid by BDL and 50% will be paid by the Board of Apprentice through DBT mode.

how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can register online through the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in/regular_student.php before the last date, 06 August 2026.
After registering as an apprentice on the portal, candidates must email their resume/CV along with their enrollment ID to [email protected].
For further queries, candidates can call 040-24587917.
The notification is also available on the official website at bdl-india.in under the path bdl-india.in/apprentice-connect.
important_instructions: Original certificates - Educational (SSC, Graduate/Diploma certificates i.e. Marksheets, Provisional/OD), Community, and PwBD certificates, etc. - must be produced by the candidate for verification as and when required. Reservations for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/CAP will be applicable as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates can register online through the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in/regular_student.php before the last date, 06 August 2026. After registering as an apprentice on the portal, candidates must email their resume/CV along with their enrollment ID to [email protected] . For further queries, candidates can call 040-24587917. The notification is also available on the official website at bdl-india.in under the path bdl-india.in/apprentice-connect.

content_sections.heading: Remuneration
content_sections.text: Graduate Apprentice (B.E./B.Tech): Rs. 12,300 per month Diploma Apprentice: Rs. 10,900 per month Of this stipend, 50% will be paid by BDL and 50% will be paid by the Board of Apprentice through DBT mode.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Original certificates - Educational (SSC, Graduate/Diploma certificates i.e. Marksheets, Provisional/OD), Community, and PwBD certificates, etc. - must be produced by the candidate for verification as and when required. Reservations for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/CAP will be applicable as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in BDL Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 147 vacancies have been announced – 122 for Graduate Apprentice and 25 for Diploma Apprentice.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for BDL Graduate Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates who have passed B.E./B.Tech in 2022 or later in the specified engineering disciplines are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for BDL Diploma Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates who have passed Diploma in 2022 or later in the specified technical fields are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for BDL Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for BDL Apprenticeship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register online through the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in) and then email their resume/CV along with enrollment ID to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for BDL Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices will receive ₹12,300 per month (50% by BDL, 50% by Board of Apprentice via DBT).

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for BDL Diploma Apprentice?
faq.answer: Diploma Apprentices will receive ₹10,900 per month (50% by BDL, 50% by Board of Apprentice via DBT).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for BDL Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification for BDL Apprenticeship 2026?
faq.answer: The notification is available on the official website: bdl-india.in/apprentice-connect.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for verification?
faq.answer: Original certificates – Educational (SSC, Graduate/Diploma marksheets, Provisional/OD), Community, and PwBD certificates, etc. – must be produced for verification as and when required.
